title: Annotated Code of Maryland, Real Property Article, Title 8 - Landlord and Tenant
source_id: Md. Code, Real Prop. Title 8 (esp. § 8-203, security deposits)
verified_how: Fetched the section page for Article - Real Property, § 8-203: live text opening 'In this section the following words have the meanings indicated', then the security-deposit regime - deposit limits, interest, handling, damage claims, tenant protections and surety bonds as an alternative to a cash deposit. Served with enactments=false; no as-at date printed.
notes: Title 8 carries the residential tenancy obligations (§ 8-203 security deposits, § 8-208 prohibited lease provisions, § 8-211 rent escrow for serious defects). Summary ejectment and failure-to-pay-rent procedure is in the same article at Title 8, Subtitle 4 and in Md. Code, Real Prop. § 8-401. General consumer protection is a separate statute, the Maryland Consumer Protection Act, Md. Code, Com. Law Title 13.
